title: Cube Calculator
description: Enter a cube’s side length to get its volume, surface area, face diagonal and space diagonal.
howto: Read the volume, surface area and diagonals with formulas.

faqs.a: The longest line inside the cube, from one corner to the opposite corner: s√3.
A cube has 6 identical square faces, each of area s².

faqs.q: Can I work backwards from volume?
faqs.a: Yes — the side is the cube root of the volume: s = ∛v.
